record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo (Clobbopus 1 star, Grapploct 2 stars, passive NONE) declare OCTOLOCK in this production reference. Shared strategy.
record.summary: SPECIAL 30 / 60 / 90 / 180 (fallback 180) FIRST, then locked and armorReduction on the original target with the same requested duration 3000 / 3000 / 6000 / 10000 (no AP / crit scaling). The target supplies the reductions. The two statuses refuse independently: skydiving, ccCooldown, IMMUNITY_LOCKED or an existing lock refuse only the lock, Rune Protect refuses both. A new armor reduction cannot change this cast's damage; one already active does halve the target's SPE_DEF in the hit.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); a cast crit multiplies by critPower reduced by the target's critReductionFactor (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested amount = raw x AP x crit factor; applied: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x speDef) with speDef halved (Math.round) if the target ALREADY had armor reduction before this cast, ceil, minimum 1, shield first; the returned takenDamage is not used by this ability. Blocked (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Both statuses are still requested after a blocked hit (executed).

statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the damage, before armor reduction
statusEffects.guards: Refused when the target is already locked (existing timer kept: 800), skydiving, has Rune Protect, has IMMUNITY_LOCKED, or has ccCooldown > 0 (all executed); an enraged target gets half the duration (1500); then the target's reductions (HYDRATION 1500, Swift Swim x0.7, Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3, Odd Keystone); the cooldown is the rounded result. Refusal does not stop the armor reduction.
statusEffects.combatEffect: On application the target's range is forced to 1 (a retarget when it was not 1: executed with range 3). Locked is one term in the canMove and canBeMoved getters (pokemon-entity.ts:235, 261), in the dodge guard (pokemon-state.ts:107) and the dark-type jump condition (moving-state.ts:87); only the locked term was read, not the other conditions at those sites, and canAttack / canCast do not test locked. When it ends the range is restored and ccCooldown refuses a new lock for its duration.

statusEffects.guards: Refused only by Rune Protect (executed: it refuses both statuses); not stopped by a refused lock or a Protected hit. The duration passes through the target's reductions (HYDRATION 1500; enraged does NOT halve it: 3000); a new value replaces the remaining time only if longer (9000 kept).
statusEffects.combatEffect: While active, handleDamage uses round(def / 2) and round(speDef / 2) for damage the target takes. Executed: this cast's own hit is computed before the new reduction (SPE_DEF 20 -> 15 returned), while a reduction already active halves SPE_DEF in the same hit (SPE_DEF 10 -> 20 returned). Stored stat values are unchanged.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; the 3-star and 4-star entries (damage 90 / 180, duration 6000 / 10000) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Clobbopus 1, Grapploct 2). maxPP 65 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (range 1 for both units).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. A second cast during LOCKED does not re-lock (no stacking) but still applies damage and can lengthen armor reduction; after LOCKED ends the CC cooldown refuses a new lock for its duration.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 30 / 60 / 90 / 180, duration 3000 / 3000 / 6000 / 10000 for both statuses. Damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (halved SPE_DEF only if an armor reduction was already active), ceil, at least 1. Durations are requested values: enraged halves the lock only; the target's reductions shorten both; the lock may be refused while the armor reduction applies.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Shield, Cover Band, Fossil and resurrection branches of handleDamage were not traced here (takenDamage is unused by OCTOLOCK); consulted core-mechanics.md section A and the speDef step only
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
The value of CC_COOLDOWN and whether other systems read status.locked were not exhaustively searched (app/core and app/models were grepped; other directories were not)
unresolved: How a locked unit's basic attacks or casts behave beyond canMove / canBeMoved / dodge / dark jump was not traced further
Whether passives or items change LOCKED or armorReduction beyond those listed (a passive resets lockedCooldown at app/core/effects/passives.ts:1682, not read in detail)
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue; units not listed are not covered

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (triggerLocked, triggerArmorReduction, handleSpecialDamage) and the real OctolockStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in target): the order damage, locked, armorReduction, the star durations, independent refusals, enrage / HYDRATION effects, the range forcing, and the damage with and without an armor reduction already active.
